explication: Bats-core is a Bash testing framework: users provide Bash test files, Bats discovers and runs their cases, and reports results in TAP-compatible formats. The tree shows separate CLI, execution, preprocessing, and formatter modules, plus runtime support for setup, tracing, warnings, and parallel coordination. The README establishes the user workflow and TAP behavior, but only package.json was sampled; internal calls and dispatch are therefore shown as unverified rather than asserted.
